highlights: 30‑year Treasury bond yield remained flat at 5.175%.
Core PCE rose 0.2% month‑over‑month and 3.3% year‑over‑year, matching forecasts.
Oil prices fell as Iran and Oman neared a transit deal, with Brent at $86.08 per barrel.

canada_us_tariffs_2026_08_26.headline: Canada Imposes $20 Billion Retaliatory Tariffs on U.S. Goods
canada_us_tariffs_2026_08_26.summary: Canada announced matching tariffs on over 700 U.S. products worth about $20 billion, ranging from 15% to 50%, effective Sept 8.
highlights: Tariffs include 50% duties on American steel and aluminum.
Canada unveiled a $7.5 billion aid package for affected businesses and workers.

mecca_pact_membership_2026_08_26.headline: Bangladesh Mulls Mecca Pact Membership, Risking India Relations
mecca_pact_membership_2026_08_26.summary: Bangladesh is considering joining the Saudi‑Turkey‑Pakistan Mecca defence pact, a move that could strain its delicate diplomatic and economic ties with India.
highlights: Bangladesh invited to join Saudi‑Turkey‑Pakistan mutual defence agreement
Joining could test Dhaka’s non‑aligned foreign policy and affect export‑driven economy
India likely to oppose membership due to inclusion of Pakistan

china_education_cooperation_2026_08_26.headline: China to Deepen Educational Cooperation with Bangladesh, Launches First Chinese Language Standard
china_education_cooperation_2026_08_26.summary: Chinese Ambassador Yao Wen announced that China will expand educational ties with Bangladesh, turning new Chinese language competency standards into job opportunities for Bangladeshi youth.
highlights: Bangladesh's National Skills Development Authority released the first Chinese language competency standard and course
Ambassador Yao Wen said the workshop reflects the leaders' consensus and will foster practical cooperation across multiple

fed_jackson_hole_2026.headline: Fed Chair Warsh’s Jackson Hole Speech Could Tilt Dollar and Bond Markets
fed_jackson_hole_2026.summary: Investors await Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s keynote at Jackson Hole, fearing his tone may sway the dollar, Treasury yields and inflation outlook.
highlights: Treasury announced a $4 billion boost to long‑term bond buybacks, aiming to curb a sell‑off in yields
30‑year Treasury yield hit a 19‑year high while 10‑year yield hovered near the critical 5% level

atlas_nuclear_meeting_2026_08_26.headline: Bangladesh Eyes Maritime SMR Opportunities at ATLAS 2026 Summit
atlas_nuclear_meeting_2026_08_26.summary: Bangladesh's science minister highlighted advanced nuclear small modular reactors for maritime use, stressing low‑carbon power, energy security and climate benefits.
highlights: ATLAS 2026 gathered Bangladesh and 19 other nations, with US Energy Secretary Chris Wright and IAEA chief Rafael Grossi speaking.
Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant Unit 1 recently achieved physical start‑up, marking Bangladesh's first nuclear reactor.
Bangladesh supports the global goal to triple nuclear capacity by 2050 and seeks floating SMR deployment.

mintoo_rangeland_protection_2026_08_26.headline: Bangladesh Minister Calls for Community Role in Rangeland Protection
mintoo_rangeland_protection_2026_08_26.summary: Minister Abdul Awal Mintoo urged local communities to help protect shrinking rangelands and integrate livestock production with environmental conservation to boost rural livelihoods.
highlights: Livestock sector contributes about 2% to Bangladesh’s GDP.
Grazing areas are declining due to population pressure and land‑use changes.
Community‑based management in Tanguar Haor has improved biodiversity conservation.

bd_nepal_flood_support_2026_08_26.headline: Bangladesh Pledges Relief Assistance to Nepal After Devastating Floods and Mudslide
bd_nepal_flood_support_2026_08_26.summary: Bangladesh announced its readiness to support Nepal’s relief and rescue operations following deadly flash floods and a mudslide that left hundreds missing.
highlights: Bangladesh’s foreign ministry expressed solidarity with Nepal’s government and people
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman offered condolences and pledged any needed assistance
The disaster has caused numerous deaths and many missing, including tourists

oil_hormuz_mid_aug2026.headline: European Shares Flat as Nvidia Earnings Loom and Oil Prices Dip on Strait of Hormuz Hope
oil_hormuz_mid_aug2026.summary: European markets held steady ahead of Nvidia’s results, while optimism that the Strait of Hormuz may reopen pushed oil prices lower, easing inflation concerns.
highlights: STOXX 600 edged up 0.06% with luxury stocks gaining 1.2%
Investors await Nvidia’s earnings later in the day
ECB is expected to raise rates at its September meeting

tbsnews.net/world/us-says-chinese-hacker.headline: US Disrupts Chinese Hackers Targeting Justice Department, Federal Reserve and NASA
tbsnews.net/world/us-says-chinese-hacker.summary: The United States seized domains used by Chinese hacking platforms, exposing a campaign that compromised the Justice Department, NASA, the Federal Reserve and other agencies.
highlights: Two platforms, QScan and QTRouter, were linked to Nanjing Xinjiuwei Network Technology Company.
Victims included the Department of Energy, Health and Human Services, NIH and firms in the US and South Korea.

cnbc.com/2026/08/27/india-us-russia-ener.headline: U.S. and Russia vie for larger slice of India's energy market
cnbc.com/2026/08/27/india-us-russia-ener.summary: India's growing demand for crude, LPG and LNG has sparked a geopolitical contest as the U.S. and Russia compete for greater market share amid tariffs and supply constraints.
highlights: Russia supplies over 50% of India's crude imports in June‑July, while the U.S. provides more than 70% of India's LPG imports.
Indian imports of Venezuelan crude rose to 383,000 barrels per day in August, accounting for about 11% of total crude imports.

cnbc.com/2026/08/26/crowdstrikes-shows-a.headline: CrowdStrike Beats Estimates as AI Fuels Cybersecurity Surge
cnbc.com/2026/08/26/crowdstrikes-shows-a.summary: CrowdStrike reported 26% revenue growth and a 35% EPS rise, highlighting AI-driven demand for its Falcon platform and a record NNARR of $333 million.
highlights: Revenue rose to $1.47 billion, surpassing consensus estimates
NNARR jumped 51% year‑over‑year to $333 million
LogScale SIEM ARR grew 60% as AI adoption accelerated

us_inflation_july_2026.headline: Wall Street Slides as July Inflation Hits 3.7% Ahead of Nvidia Earnings
us_inflation_july_2026.summary: U.S. inflation rose to 3.7% in July, slightly above forecasts, prompting modest declines in the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq ahead of Nvidia’s results.
highlights: July PCE index climbed 3.7%, outpacing the 3.6% estimate
Dow fell 0.25%, S&P 500 slipped 0.03%, Nasdaq down 0.18%
Investors await Nvidia’s earnings for insight into AI‑driven demand

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/china-assessing-f.headline: China and Bangladesh Explore Teesta River Project and Renewable Energy Cooperation
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/china-assessing-f.summary: China and Bangladesh are jointly assessing the feasibility of the Teesta River project while expanding cooperation in solar power, waste‑to‑energy and infrastructure development.
highlights: Chinese Ambassador Yao Wen announced feasibility studies for the Teesta River project after meeting Bangladesh’s LGRD Minister.
China pledged support for Bangladesh’s solar and renewable energy, waste‑to‑energy, and slum modernisation projects.
Ongoing China‑Bangladesh cooperation includes a new Special Economic Zone in Chattogram and the Mongla Port project.

tbsnews.net/economy/banking/bangladesh-b.headline: Bangladesh Bank Reviews Loan Recovery and Restructuring of Sammilito Islami Bank
tbsnews.net/economy/banking/bangladesh-b.summary: Bangladesh Bank’s resolution team evaluated progress on loan recovery, board reconstitution, staff integration and IT consolidation at Sammilito Islami Bank.
highlights: Around 10,000 loan recovery cases have been filed, with more pending.
The bank’s board now includes more independent directors and a new CEO appointed on 16 July 2026.
Integration of IT systems across five merged banks, including CBS, SWIFT and RMA, is underway.

tbsnews.net/foreign-policy/lgrd-minister.headline: Bangladesh LGRD Minister Seeks Expanded Chinese Cooperation in Infrastructure and Waste Management
tbsnews.net/foreign-policy/lgrd-minister.summary: Minister Dr Abdul Moyeen Khan announced plans to deepen Chinese partnership in infrastructure, ports, waste management and a Taka 10,000 crore housing project for Dhaka slums.
highlights: China will fund a Taka 10,000 crore modern housing scheme for Korail, Sat Tala and Bhashantek slums
The Dasherkandi Sewage Treatment Plant will become fully operational after pipeline network expansion

cnbc.com/2026/08/27/china-industrial-pro.headline: China July Industrial Profit Growth Slows to 11.2% Amid Weak Demand
cnbc.com/2026/08/27/china-industrial-pro.summary: July industrial profits rose 11.2% year‑on‑year, the slowest pace this year, as weak domestic demand and falling property investment curb growth.
highlights: Integrated circuit sector contributed over 80% of profit gains with 18.5% growth
Raw materials manufacturers posted a 55.2% profit increase year‑to‑date

cnbc.com/2026/08/26/jensen-huang-defends.headline: Nvidia CEO Defends Massive AI Financing, Calls Risk Low
cnbc.com/2026/08/26/jensen-huang-defends.summary: Jensen Huang said Nvidia’s $500 billion financing push for AI startups and data centers carries low risk, arguing the capital‑intensive nature of frontier AI.
highlights: Nvidia reported $96.2 billion revenue, with data‑center sales up 117% year‑over‑year.
The company pledged $105 billion for an Ohio compute campus that will host OpenAI.

cnbc.com/2026/08/27/korea-bok-rate-hike-.headline: Bank of Korea Raises Rate to 3% Amid Persistent Core Inflation
cnbc.com/2026/08/27/korea-bok-rate-hike-.summary: The Bank of Korea lifted its policy rate by 25 basis points to 3%, its highest since January 2025, as core inflation hit 2.6%.
highlights: Core inflation climbed to 2.6% in July, the highest level since December 2023.
Housing prices in Seoul jumped 2.5% month‑on‑month in June, the biggest rise in five years.
The economy expanded 3.7% in the second quarter, driven by strong export demand, especially from the semiconductor sector.
